title: Code for: Comparative survival associations and coexpression pathways of CCNE1 and CCNE2 in breast cancer
description: Analysis code for a retrospective study of CCNE1 and CCNE2 expression and overall survival in TCGA-BRCA, METABRIC and SCAN-B, including coexpression pathway analyses and additional analyses of proliferation, paralog contrast, copy number and tumor purity.
